The '''''Crecsent''''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] passenger [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned by [[Nuun Pargen]].

==History==
The ''Crescent'' took off [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] with passengers onboard. While it was trying to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], it was attacked and damaged by [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], Nuun Pargen, managed to make an emergency landing outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]].
